changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE players ADD CONSTRAINT ck_player_non_playing_profile CHECK (CASE WHEN non_playing_profile_hex IS NOT NULL AND non_playing_profile_sha256 IS NOT NULL THEN LENGTH(non_playing_profile_hex)=104 AND LENGTH(non_playing_profile_sha256)=64 ELSE non_playing_profile_hex IS NULL AND non_playing_profile_sha256 IS NULL END)

ALTER TABLE staff ADD CONSTRAINT ck_staff_non_playing_profile CHECK (CASE WHEN non_playing_profile_hex IS NOT NULL AND non_playing_profile_sha256 IS NOT NULL THEN LENGTH(non_playing_profile_hex)=104 AND LENGTH(non_playing_profile_sha256)=64 ELSE non_playing_profile_hex IS NULL AND non_playing_profile_sha256 IS NULL END)

rollback.sql: SELECT 1 / CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players WHERE non_playing_profile_hex IS NOT NULL OR non_playing_profile_sha256 IS NOT NULL) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff WHERE non_playing_profile_hex IS NOT NULL OR non_playing_profile_sha256 IS NOT NULL)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
ALTER TABLE players DROP CONSTRAINT ck_player_non_playing_profile
ALTER TABLE staff DROP CONSTRAINT ck_staff_non_playing_profile
